title: Pokémon_Mansion
lead_summary:
Pokémon Mansion was burnt down due to a scientific experiment gone wrong. The player needs to find Blaine so he can open his Gym.
Secret switches are hiding at the base of statues, which toggles gates to open and close on all floors of the Mansion.

items.name: Burn Heal
items.location_details: Given by Pyromaniac Julio after defeating him.

items.name: Full Heal
items.location_details: Hidden by a boulder in the northeast corner.

items.name: Carbos
items.location_details: After dropping from 3F, pass the stairs.

items.name: Heat Rock
items.location_details: Hidden by a boulder at the top.

items.name: Hyper Potion
items.location_details: After taking the South-East Stairs from 3F.

items.name: Escape Rope
items.location_details: Given by Scientist Ivan after defeating him.

items.name: Rare Candy
items.location_details: In a small room North behind a gate.

items.name: Fire Stone
items.location_details: Hidden by a boulder in the last room.
